title: Shinonome Ena — The Best Angle For The Perfect Pic〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Best Angle For The Perfect Pic（3★）
meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hi, how's it going?
Hm? Where's Yuki...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, she said she has to study for her practice exam, so she won't be able to work today...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm kinda worried.
She didn't seem herself yesterday either.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But she's always talking about how it's for the sake of my future... So, not really...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Instead of spending my time on music, I should be doing things that will help me with entrance exams... Because that's what is best for me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So... I have to... Give up music...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki... Mafuyu seemed like she was in pain.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's tough since she's hoping to meet her mom's expectations but actually wants to do something else entirely...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But this is someone else's family we're talking about... And I get that she cares about her mom.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But if I were in her shoes, we would've gotten into a huge fight.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I can see that with you, Ena, but that's just...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know. I'm just speculating and not actually thinking about Mafuyu's actual situation.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I know that...
But it's still unbelievably frustrating.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <All she has to do is say what she wants to do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, who else but Mafuyu's in a position to say anything to her mom?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes, we're still technically kids and I probably sound pretty conceited right now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <There's no way I'd ever want to be a puppet for my parents to control.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She should just let it all out...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm tired! I look and I look and I look and I look!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I just can't find it...
Then when I look again, it's just not right and I get depressed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What am I even supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At the very least, she wasn't lying. Everything she said came from within her.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So I kinda just want her to let it all out using whatever words she feels are appropriate.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You say that, Ena, but I can already see you getting mad.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Of course I'd be mad.
Does she not realize that we're worried sick about her?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Oh, Enanan.
We wouldn't have you any other way♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm worried about Mafuyu too, but like you said, Enanan, she was able to tell us exactly how she felt that time...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I think providing her a place where she doesn't have to be a “good girl” is the best thing we can do for her right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, totally! You good with that, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, okay. I mean, that's honestly about all we can do for her right now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sorry, you two...
I know there's sort of no point talking about this without her actually being here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be fair, since yesterday and all throughout today, I've been worried about her too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now, let's regroup and get back to work!>
